topic: How does L-DACS integration impact spectrum sharing between A2G and satellite links in congested airspaces?
response: L-DACS integration mitigates saturation in A2G communication systems, potentially reducing interference with satellite links. L-DACS1 and L-DACS2 operate differently, with L-DACS1 offering full-duplex transmission and L-DACS2 using half-duplex.
reference_context: L-DACS is a data link for mitigating A2G communication saturation, with two candidates: L-DACS1 and L-DACS2, differing in transmission methods.
